what: Figures of the page How it works (frontend/app/how-it-works) that are stated in the documents and held in no other outcome file. Each value carries the run or source it is from and the place that states it; `stores` was read from the served stores themselves. Counts and names only: no question of the test set, no answer, no passage. frontend/scripts/how-figures.mjs reads this file; every other figure of the page is counted from the other outcome files, from backend/app/settings.py, or from the code.

stores.stated: read from the served stores themselves on 2026-11-23, read-only: the graph's own components, indexes and label counts; the collection's own version and configuration

pages.run: the literature gold's second check: a seeded sample, 15 pages per grade, one page per call, without the first grade or reason
pages.stated: EVALUATION.md, "Read this first" (its first item) and the table of "How the literature gold was made"

answers.run: the mark 'gives what the question asks' given again on the 205 literature answers of the five runs of the first row of 'One writer, different evidence and settings'
answers.stated: EVALUATION.md, "A stronger writer, and a second judge" (the paragraph "A second judge" and its table)

vector_numbers.run: the stored vectors of the literature collection and the question's embedding

weaviate_version.stated: EVALUATION.md, "How small can the literature collection be"

points_a_question.run: one question as a share of the catalogue questions (1 of 80: 1.25 points) and of each part of the sealed set (1 of 20: 5 points)
points_a_question.stated: EVALUATION.md, "Read this first" (its last item, which gives the size of one question for every set)

spend_limit.run: the monthly spend limit of the model key's workspace, set at the provider and kept low; its amount is not published
spend_limit.stated: docs/OPERATIONS.md, "What the limits are, and what they are not" (not in EVALUATION.md)

trace.stated: The traced question as the served system returned it on 2026-11-23, through the eval's way in to the public service: asked after a first question about the same issue; scores as returned. The opening question's answer, the passages and the timings are left out.

after.en: a question about the Bernardo Soto 1889 issue
after.es: una pregunta sobre la emisión Bernardo Soto de 1889

trace.searched: Who printed the Bernardo Soto 1889 issue?

caption.en: Found by vector, by year and by title, then read from the graph
caption.es: Encontradas por vector, por año y por título, y leídas después en el grafo

answer.text: The Bernardo Soto 1889 issue was printed by Waterlow & Sons.

note.en: The issue the question means came second: the 1887 issue of the same name scores higher. Each card carries its own printer, read from the graph, and the answer cites the card it rests on.
note.es: La emisión de la que habla la pregunta quedó segunda: la de 1887, del mismo nombre, puntúa más alto. Cada ficha trae su propio impresor, leído del grafo, y la respuesta cita la ficha en la que se apoya.
